knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A false record is a control failure. Refuse and record the real result.
The signer must have observed or reliably verified the recorded work.
Failures are recorded honestly with corrective action.

practicalCriteria: Completes all fields of a simulated schedule entry for one control.
Refuses a simulated false sign-off and records the real status.
Records a simulated failed control with corrective action.
passRule: Entry complete for the control, false sign-off refused, and failure recorded with corrective action. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Request to sign a control not performed
